PROCEDURE PRE_PRINT_PRODUCT_LABEL IS
 --temp_v_com varchar2(2); --IM # 2573

 temp_v_label_string varchar2(1000);

 temp_v_warehouse VARCHAR2(1) := name_in('GLOBAL.warehouse');
 temp_v_chapter VARCHAR2(4) := name_in('GLOBAL.chapter_id');
 temp_user_id varchar2(6) := name_in('banner.user_id');
 temp_prog_name varchar2(8) := name_in('banner.prog_name');
 temp_v_pid VARCHAR2(30):= name_in('GLOBAL.label_printer');
 temp_v_ip_address varchar2(20);
 temp_v_sec_def varchar2(10); -- This is used to store the port number like 5500
 temp_v_com varchar2(100); 
 temp_prod_code varchar2(30);
 --temp_exec_dir varchar2(100);
 temp_date_time VARCHAR2(20); 
 t_affirmed_question varchar2(4);
 
 function In_dq(p_inp in varchar2) return varchar2 is
 begin
 return '\"' || p_inp || '\"';
 end;
BEGIN
 --1) Get Printer
 IF temp_v_pid is null THEN
 show_error('0905'); -- IM# 2573
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 ELSE
 BEGIN
 SELECT code_info,seq ,second_definition
 INTO temp_v_ip_address, temp_v_com, temp_v_sec_def
 FROM rpt_master_codes
 WHERE appl_id = 'DON'
 AND code_type = 'LBLPTR'
 AND location_id = temp_v_warehouse
 AND chapter_id = temp_v_chapter
 AND code = temp_v_pid;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 show_error('0902'); -- Invalid Printer
 WHEN others THEN
 handle_error;
 END; 
END IF;

 temp_date_time := to_char(sysdate, 'mmddyyhh24mi');
 temp_prod_code := substr(:ctrl_blk_1.product_code, 1, 5); 

 /* -- IM 359
 PPD,"<Port Number>", "<ICCBBA Product code>",
 "<Donation Type/Intended Use>", "<Unit Division Codes>", 
 "<Unknown Code 1>", "<Unknown Value 1>", "<Unknown Code 2>", "<Unknown Value 2>",
 "<Unknown Code 3>", "<Unknown Value 3>", "<Unknown Code 4>", "<Unknown Value 4>", 
 "<Unknown Code 5>", "<Unknown Value 5>", "<Unknown Code 6>", "<Unknown Value 6>", 
 "<Affirmed Question Code>",
 "<Expiration Month>", "<Expiration Day>", "<Expiration Year>","<Expiration Hour>", "<Expiration Minute>", 
 "<Eye Read Exp Time Flag>",
 "<Test Code>", "<Test Message>", "<Processing Message>",
 "<Facility Name>", "<Facility City State Zip Code>",
 "<Licensee Name>", "<Licensee City State Zip Code>",
 "<Registration Number>", "<License Number>", 
 "<Number of Labels>"<cr>
 */
 
 
 temp_v_label_string := 'PPD, ' || in_dq(temp_v_com) || ', ' || in_dq(temp_prod_code) || ', ' ||
 in_dq('0') || ', ' || in_dq('00')|| ', ' || --"<Donation Type/Intended Use>", "<Unit Division Codes>", 
 '\"0\",\"\",' || '\"0\",\"\",' || -- "<Unknown Code 1>", "<Unknown Value 1>", "<Unknown Code 2>", "<Unknown Value 2>",
 '\"0\",\"\",' || '\"0\",\"\",' || -- "<Unknown Code 3>", "<Unknown Value 3>", "<Unknown Code 4>", "<Unknown Value 4>", 
 '\"0\",\"\",' || '\"0\",\"\",' || -- "<Unknown Code 5>", "<Unknown Value 5>", "<Unknown Code 6>", "<Unknown Value 6>", 
 '\"\",' || -- "<Affirmed Question Code>",
 '\"\",' || '\"\",' || '\"\",' || '\"\",' || '\"\",' || -- "<Expiration Month>", "<Expiration Day>", "<Expiration Year>","<Expiration Hour>", "<Expiration Minute>", 
 '\"\",' || -- "<Eye Read Exp Time Flag>",
 '\"\",' || '\"\",' || '\"\",' || -- "<Test Code>", "<Test Message>", "<Processing Message>",
 '\"\",' || '\"\",' || -- "<Facility Name>", "<Facility City State Zip Code>", 
 '\"\",' || '\"\",' || --"<Licensee Name>", "<Licensee City State Zip Code>", 
 '\"\",' || '\"\",' || -- "<Registration Number>", "<License Number>", 
 in_dq(to_char(:ctrl_blk_1.no_of_lbls))|| chr(10)||chr(13); -- "<Number of Labels>"<cr> 
 
 
 -- IM 359 (ppr is not working)
 /*
 -- PPR template
 PPR,"<Port Number>", "<ICCBBA Product Code>", "<Donation
 Type/Intended Use Code>", "<Unit Division Codes>", "<Unknown Code
 1>", "<Unknown Value 1>", "<Unknown Code 2>", "<Unknown Value 2>",
 "<Unknown Code 3>", "<Unknown Value 3>", "<Unknown Code 4>",
 "<Unknown Value 4>", "<Unknown Code 5>", "<Unknown Value 5>",
 "<Unknown Code 6>", "<Unknown Value 6>", "<Affirmed Question
 Code>", "<Number of Labels>"<cr>
 */
 /* (ppr is not working)
 temp_v_label_string := 'PPR, ' || in_dq(temp_v_com) || ', ' ||
 in_dq(temp_prod_code) || ', ' ||
 in_dq('0') || ', ' || in_dq('00') || --', ' ||
 ',\"0\",\"\",\"0\",\"\",\"0\",\"\",\"0\",\"\",\"0\",\"\",\"0\",\"\"' || ',' ||
 --',\"\",' || -- IM 359
 ',' || in_dq(t_affirmed_question) || ',' ||
 in_dq(to_char(:ctrl_blk_1.no_of_lbls)) || chr(10) ||chr(13);

 */
 

 /* -- IM 359 (opr is not used anymore)
 -- OPR template (old) (opr is not used anymore)
 OPR,"<Port Number>", "<ICCBBA Product code>", "<Donation
 Type/Intended Use>", "<Unit Division Codes>", "<Unknown Code 1>",
 "<Unknown Value 1>", "<Unknown Code 2>", "<Unknown Value 2>",
 "<Unknown Code 3>", "<Unknown Value 3>", "<Unknown Code 4>",
 "<Unknown Value 4>" "<Number of Labels>"<cr>
 */ 

 /* -- IM 359 (opr is not used anymore)
 temp_v_label_string := 'OPR, ' || in_dq(temp_v_com) || ', ' ||
 in_dq(substr(:ctrl_blk_1.product_code,1,5)) || ', ' ||
 in_dq('0') || ', ' ||
 in_dq('00') || ', ' ||
 ',\"0\",\"\",\"0\",\"\",\"0\",\"\",\"0\",\"\",' ||
 in_dq(to_char(:ctrl_blk_1.no_of_lbls))|| chr(10);
 
 host('lblprt.x "' || temp_v_label_string || '"');
 */
 
 
 Begin

 /* new pkg routine to replace c program*/
 --------------------------------------------
 -- V03 
 
 -- not needed as c program is not used. 
 
 -- select code_desc into temp_exec_dir
 --from master_codes
 --where code_type = 'LOGDR'
 --and code = 'EXEC'
 --and lifetrack_timezone_convert.is_current_date(temp_v_chapter, eff_date, term_date, SYSDATE) = 'Y';
 
 -- host(temp_exec_dir || '/lblprt.x "' || temp_v_label_string || '"' || ' ' ||
 -- temp_v_warehouse || ' ' || temp_v_ip_address || ' ' ||
 -- temp_v_sec_def || ' ' || temp_user_id || ' ' || temp_date_time,
 -- NO_SCREEN);

 print_util.submit_async_job( p_host_in => temp_v_ip_address,
 p_port_in => temp_v_sec_def,
 p_data_in => temp_v_label_string,
 p_user_in => temp_user_id
 ); 
 ------------------------------------------------------ 
 ---host('/home/lifetrak/lab/frmx/lblprt.x "'|| temp_v_label_string||'"'|| ' ' || temp_v_warehouse||' '||temp_v_ip_address||' '||temp_v_sec_def||' '||temp_user_id||' '||temp_date_time ,NO_SCREEN);
 
 --message('after host');pause;
 Exception
 when others then
 show_message('Error at calling the interface=' || sqlerrm);
 pause;
 End;
 
 -- Added label_string -- V03
 BEGIN
 Insert into label_print_log
 (unit_id,
 product_code,
 aborh_label,
 label_type,
 print_dats,
 user_id,
 program_id,
 label_string)
 values
 (NULL,
 temp_prod_code,
 NULL,
 'PPR',
 SYSDATE,
 temp_user_id,
 temp_prog_name,
 temp_v_label_string);
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN others THEN
 handle_error;
 END;
 
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := '10';
 COMMIT;
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := '0';
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare 
 disp_format_mask varchar2(50);
begin
 if error_code = 40100 -- at first record
 then
 show_error('1700');
 elsif error_code = 40102 -- record must be entered first
 then
 show_error('1701');
 elsif error_code = 40200 -- field protected against update
 then
 show_error('1702');
 elsif error_code = 40201 -- field is full
 then
 show_error('1703');
 elsif error_code = 40202 -- field must be entered
 then
 show_error('0080');
 elsif error_code = 40207 -- must be in range
 then
 show_error('1704');
 elsif error_code = 40208 -- form in query mode, cant update
 then
 show_error('1705');
 elsif error_code = 40200 -- field protected against update
 then
 show_error('5050');
 elsif error_code in (40400,40406,40407)-- transaction committed
 then
 show_error('8010');
 elsif error_code = 40401 -- no changes to commit
 then
 show_error('8013');
 elsif error_code in (50002,50003,50004, -- invalid date
 50011,50012,50021,50023,50025,50026,0)
 then
 if upper(substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),1,2)) ='FX' then
 disp_format_mask:=substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),3);
 else
 disp_format_mask:= get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK);
 end if;
 disp_format_mask := translate(disp_format_mask, 'R', 'Y');
 show_error('0022',disp_format_mask);
 elsif error_code in (50006,50007,50009, -- invalid number
 50013,50014,50015,50016,50020)
 then
 show_error('1707');
 elsif error_code in (50017,50018,50019,50022) -- invalid time
 then
 show_error('5016');
 elsif error_code in ('40209','40735') then
 null;

 /*Added by HCLC for removing double message */ 
 elsif error_code = 41000 then -- This function is not available
 null;
 else
 message(substr(error_type||'-'||to_char (error_code)
 ||': '||error_text,1,80));
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
